title: Discovery and validation of key genes and potential mechanisms linked to endothelial cell senescence and carbohydrate metabolism in recurrent spontaneous abortion.
authors: Chen, Lin; Shao, Yu; Pan, Xianshun; Lai, Ting
one_liner_zh: 该文通过生物信息学与机器学习筛选复发性流产中与糖代谢和内皮细胞衰老相关的关键基因，仅预测转录因子互作，未涉及蛋白质-DNA结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: OBJECTIVES: Recurrent spontaneous abortion (RSA) is a major pregnancy complication with largely unknown causes. Carbohydrate metabolism (CM) disorders can affect the progression of endothelial cell senescence (ES), thereby leading to placental dysfunction. However, research on the interplay between CM and ES in RSA is limited. This study aims to identify key genes at the intersection of CM- and ES-related pathways in RSA via various bioinformatics methods. METHODS: Datasets GSE165004 (training) and GSE26787 (validation) were downloaded from the GEO database. ES- and CM-related genes were obtained from previous literature. Key genes were obtained through WGCNA, two machine learning algorithms, gene expression analysis in the training and validation datasets, and RT-qPCR analysis. A comprehensive evaluation was conducted to assess the diagnostic potential of key genes. RESULTS: Two genes (BDH1, PIK3C2G) were recognized as key genes in RSA, which were upregulated in RSA. Immune infiltration analysis revealed that the key genes were negatively correlated with three distinct immune cell types. Both genes are linked to the cytokine-cytokine receptor interaction pathway. They were predicted to interact with two transcription factors (FOXL1 and YY1) and several chemicals. CONCLUSIONS: This study identifies BDH1 and PIK3C2G as candidate genes associated with CM and ES-related pathways in RSA.
abstract_zh: 目的：复发性自然流产（RSA）是一种主要妊娠并发症，其病因在很大程度上尚不明确。碳水化合物代谢（CM）紊乱可影响内皮细胞衰老（ES）的进程，从而导致胎盘功能障碍。然而，关于CM与ES在RSA中相互作用的研究有限。本研究旨在通过多种生物信息学方法，识别RSA中CM和ES相关通路交叉处的关键基因。方法：从GEO数据库下载数据集GSE165004（训练集）和GSE26787（验证集）。ES和CM相关基因来自既往文献。通过WGCNA、两种机器学习算法、训练和验证数据集中的基因表达分析以及RT-qPCR分析获得关键基因。进行综合评估以评价关键基因的诊断潜力。结果：两个基因（BDH1、PIK3C2G）被认定为RSA中的关键基因，在RSA中表达上调。免疫浸润分析显示，关键基因与三种不同免疫细胞类型呈负相关。这两个基因均与细胞因子-细胞因子受体相互作用通路相关。预测它们与两个转录因子（FOXL1和YY1）及若干化学物质存在相互作用。结论：本研究将BDH1和PIK3C2G确定为与RSA中CM和ES相关通路相关的候选基因。
